scenarios.title: Profit & Expense Health Check
scenarios.description: Quickly pinpoint hidden costs, margin leaks, and profitability drivers.
scenarios.prompt: Audit our profit and expense health: Monthly revenue $60,000, $21,000 direct product costs, and $22,000 labor. Give me a clear breakdown of where we are losing money and 3 immediate steps to fix it.
suggestedPrompts: Analyze my P&L for unexpected expense spikes

scenarios.title: Customer Territory & Market Reach
scenarios.description: Capture nearby customer demand and increase sales volume without price discounting.
scenarios.prompt: Give me 3 non-discount growth campaigns to capture 5% more neighborhood foot traffic and boost average order volume.
suggestedPrompts: Draft a local customer acquisition plan

scenarios.title: Interactive Profit & Loss Calculator
scenarios.description: Calculate daily breakeven targets and stress-test rent, labor, and product inflation.
scenarios.prompt: Model our daily operational breakeven: $4,500 monthly rent, 32% food cost, and 34% labor efficiency.
suggestedPrompts: Calculate daily sales target to break even
Optimize labor schedule to protect profit margins

scenarios.title: Products & Services Losing Money
scenarios.description: Identify unprofitable menu items or service packages diluting your bottom line.
scenarios.prompt: Audit our sales mix and identify items where rising supplier costs or labor preparation time make them unprofitable.
suggestedPrompts: Find menu items with negative contribution margins
Recalibrate pricing without losing customer volume
Create pre-portioning guidelines to stop waste

scenarios.title: Interview & Leadership Answer Builder
scenarios.description: Turn your operations history and achievements into quantified, executive-level leadership answers.
scenarios.prompt: Reframe my operations experience into high-impact leadership answers showing how I cut $35,000 in food waste and shortened kitchen wait times by 90 seconds.
suggestedPrompts: Score my resume bullets on a scale of 1-10

scenarios.title: Private Saved Reports (On Device)
scenarios.description: Access client financial models, strategy memos, and custom plans saved privately on your device.
scenarios.prompt: Show me my saved strategy artifacts, financial models, and turnaround plans.
suggestedPrompts: Export all saved models to Excel
